parsed.refutation_attempt: The sink is sendto, which merely transmits data over the network; it does not invoke any OS command interpreter. OS Command Injection requires the attacker-controlled data to be passed to a command execution primitive such as system(), execve(), popen(), or similar. No such primitive is present in the code fragment. The only potential untrusted source is buffer, but it is only read from stdin or recvfrom and then directly sent back via sendto. Therefore there is no path from untrusted input to a command execution function.
